segments.text: Kindly find our offer letter for your esteemed organisation. BCT report also enclosed.
Deepak Gupta, Om Sai Packaging Industries
Manufacturers of Corrugated Boxes & Sheets  •  Delhi Road, Saharanpur (U.P.)  •  GSTIN 09AABFO7788Q1Z3
Sub: Our offer for corrugated boxes for FY 2026-27 against your RFQ-2026-014

With reference to your above enquiry, we are pleased to submit our most competitive offer for your esteemed organisation. We have been supplying quality corrugated boxes to leading Ayurvedic and FMCG companies of the region for over fifteen years.

For 5 ply boxes, we quote 400x300x300 mm at Rs. 41.87/-, 450x350x350 mm at Rs. 51.42/-, 500x400x300 mm at Rs. 61.87/-, 500x400x400 mm at Rs. 65.27/-, 550x400x400 mm at Rs. 73.83/-, 600x400x400 mm at Rs. 76.87/-, 600x500x400 mm at Rs. 87.54/-, 650x450x450 mm at Rs. 94.06/-, 700x500x400 mm at Rs. 94.39/-, 700x500x500 mm at Rs. 112.74/-, 750x500x500 mm at Rs. 125.58/-, 800x600x500 mm at Rs. 142.95/-. We regret that we do not manufacture 5 ply in the size 600x400x300 mm; however, we can offer a 7 ply box in the same size at Rs. 73.94/- per box, which will give you better strength.

For heavy duty 7 ply boxes, our rates are 800x600x600 mm at Rs. 256.05/-, 900x600x600 mm at Rs. 253.42/-, 1000x600x600 mm at Rs. 289.40/-, 1000x800x600 mm at Rs. 350.49/-, 1200x800x800 mm at Rs. 476.70/-.

All the above rates are per box, delivered to your Haridwar plant, and exclusive of GST which will be charged extra as applicable. In case the complete order for all 30 items is placed with us, we shall be happy to extend a special discount of 5% (five percent) on the total order value.
Payment terms: 90 days from the date of delivery. Delivery: within 6 weeks from the date of purchase order. This offer is valid up to 31st December 2026.

We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified company. Our box compression (BCT) test report is enclosed herewith for your kind reference. We use minimum 60% recycled fibre, samples can be sent within 7 days, and our capacity is 1.2 lakh boxes per month.
We hope you will find our offer in order and look forward to your valued order. Assuring you of our best services at all times.
